full_page.content:
1952, July 30
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY Route 8 Huntington, Indiana
Feast of S. Ignatius July 30st, 1952- Ist Vespers My Ist Holy Mass 7/31/04
Blessed be God in all His designs!
God bless you Brother Leo-
you and yours, especially our young brothers the Novices, with whom you are now seemingly in a sort of exile from your former nest in St. Bonaventure. And of course to Fr. Alouise, for the past years (3 or 4) my next neighbor at Saint Felix's. I can hardly help missing him more than I usually do in most cases because I knew him ... as a novice and now again after close to 25 years - possibly more. However, that is the way it goes in the Order as well as in secular life; though in the latter it is very much more disapoint- ing.
Anyhow, best wishes to Fr. Alcisius and to all the novices and God's blessing to all in St. Francis, your new Novitiate. It is possible that before the summer is over I may have the privilege there for a day or so, God willing so, I'll be pleased. Till then In the mean time we'll do well to continue praying mutually for further conversion and - hearkening to our dear Lord's Own most earnest plea .... "Pray we the Lord of the Harvest that He send laborers into His harvest".
